ITEM 1 | Long thin green beans, bright green with slightly darker tips, cut into uniform pieces about 6-8 cm long and roughly 0.5 cm thick, lying in a loose heap covering roughly 35% of the plate's left and center, moist with a slight sheen, firm and holding shape | 110
ITEM 2 | Florets of green broccoli, deep green with darker purple-tinged edges and some golden-brown charred spots, clustered in a group of about 4-5 florets each roughly 2-3 cm across, slightly glossy and firm, sitting on the right side of the plate next to the chicken | 60
ITEM 3 | Pale golden-brown pieces of cooked meat with a flaky, fibrous texture and lightly browned, crisp-looking edges, two main pieces about 5 cm by 4 cm and 3 cm thick, moist with a slight sheen, sitting on the lower right of the plate beside the green beans | 130
ITEM 4 | Dark brown curled piece with a crinkled, charred-looking surface and a few darker blackened patches, about 6 cm long and 2 cm wide, dry-looking, sitting at the top right edge of the plate above the broccoli | 20
